tagline: Turn legacy code into reliable, agent-ready APIs and MCP servers.
problem: Critical business logic is trapped in legacy languages (COBOL, old Java, Fortran) that modern tools and AI cannot access.
M&A leaves enterprises with siloed legacy systems that cannot communicate.
Custom API wrappers take months to build and break whenever source code changes.
Connecting AI directly to legacy code is risky due to missing tests, lack of audit trails, and write risks.
solution: Instant ingestion: Paste a GitHub repo to automatically extract functions and generate REST APIs and MCP servers.
Unified gateway: Consolidate multiple legacy systems into a single endpoint for AI agents.
Guaranteed safety: Every operation is verified in a Docker sandbox before publishing.
Self-healing: Automatically detects source code changes, repairs broken endpoints, tests them, and versions the fix.
Dependency mapping: Visualizes shared data fields across parent and legacy systems in real time.
market: Target customers: Enterprises with inherited or acquired legacy stacks (finance, insurance, energy, manufacturing, logistics, public sector).
Buyers & users: Platform, integration, and AI engineering teams.
Adoption path: Start with low-risk, read-only data access for AI agents.
Growth driver: Enterprise AI adoption requires access to trapped legacy data.
TAM / SAM / SOM: [TBD: Market sizing data]
product: Multi-tier parsing: Combines AST parsing (tree-sitter), LLM inference, and CLI wrappers with transparency per endpoint.
Dual generation: Produces MCP servers and OpenAPI specs traced directly to source line numbers.
Safe by default: Read-only access out of the box; write actions require manual approval.
Isolated execution: Runs in an offline sandbox; AI selects endpoints but never executes unverified code.
Operational dashboard: System graph, versioning, one-click repair, rollbacks, and interactive testing.
Tenant workspaces: Isolated customer environments with token-based access.
traction: End-to-end MVP: Unified a COBOL oilfield tool and legacy Java inventory into a single MCP/REST API.
Proven self-healing: Automatically detected a renamed COBOL function, restored parity, and deployed v2 in ~6 seconds.
Live platform: Multi-workspace web dashboard running at replic8.work.
Robust foundation: Hackathon-built with 265 passing backend tests.

business_model: SaaS subscription: Tiered by connected systems and active endpoints.
Enterprise add-ons: On-premises sandboxes, custom compliance modules, and dedicated support.
Go-to-market: Land via read-only access for one team, then expand across business units and stacks.

our_advantages: Native agent support: Built-in MCP integration alongside standard REST.
Deterministic safety: Sandboxed contract tests ensure zero model-generated code errors.
Resilience: Automated self-healing and versioning prevent broken integrations.
Broad compatibility: Works directly on raw source across legacy languages.
